deployments_detail.use: Helena - generative AI virtual assistant (Azure OpenAI/ChatGPT) for real-time customer support; also enables sending Express parcels via WhatsApp

Helena, a generative-AI virtual assistant on the CTT website answering customer questions on parcel status, postal codes, addresses, shipping and services 24/7. Built by Devoteam/Singularity on Microsoft Azure OpenAI (ChatGPT). [Microsoft Azure OpenAI (ChatGPT); developed by Devoteam / Singularity]
deployments_detail.value: ~2,500 daily contacts at peak season; NPS improved from -10 to +30; ~30% reduction in customer support calls

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered dynamic contact form / self-service tool that interprets customers' written messages, routes them to relevant help articles, and collects the right information (tracking numbers, plates, tax IDs) to speed up resolution. Built by Portuguese startup Cleverly using ML trained on customer-support data. [Cleverly (Portuguese ML startup)]
deployments_detail.value: ~20% of contacts resolved via help articles in the first month

deployments_detail.use: Sprinklr unified CXM platform (Modern Engagement/Research/Care) using AI to automatically route emails and calls to more efficient channels and power social listening and customer-care automation. [Sprinklr]

Strategic investment (via CTT's Fundo 1520 innovation fund) in Portuguese conversational-AI company Agentifai, whose 'Alice' voice assistant automates customer interactions; positions CTT to extend generative-AI customer support into voice channels. [Agentifai (voice AI 'Alice')]
deployments_detail.value: Agentifai serves 4M+ users and automates 55%+ of interactions (vendor-wide, not CTT-specific)

deployments_detail.use: CTT invested in Agentifai (Braga AI startup) whose voice-AI robot answers phone/app customer inquiries

Fleet of autonomous logistics robots (RoboSavvy TugBots plus a Kuka robotic arm) orchestrated by MOV.AI's robot operating system to feed the parcel-sorting machine, replacing hazardous manual pallet/box handling in a CTT sorting facility. [MOV.AI (robot OS); RoboSavvy TugBots; KUKA arm]
deployments_detail.value: over 10,000 parcels sorted per hour, 24/7; started with 2 TugBots + 1 arm, scaled to 3 TugBots

deployments_detail.use: In-house AI-based 'Tray Vision' software used to monitor sorting trays at CTT's operations hub, developed by CTT's internal engineering team. [CTT (in-house)]

Locker capacity-management system (in development) using AI to predict parcel-locker volumes and redirect packages to alternative Locky lockers/pickup points; part of CTT's in-house-developed out-of-home network software. [CTT (in-house)]

Migration of critical workloads to Microsoft Azure to establish an AI-ready, secure platform, cutting environment provisioning from over a week to hours so development teams can build and deploy AI solutions. [Microsoft Azure]
deployments_detail.value: 15% cost savings from the migration; migration pays for itself in ~6 years
